sourceTitle: Financial arrangements of a foster carer (Argyll and Bute Council)

allowances.label: 5 to 10
allowances.note: The council's breakdown table on the same page adds up to £310.51 for this age band, so ask the fostering team which figure applies

allowances.label: 16 to 17
allowances.note: The council's breakdown table on the same page adds up to £403.55 for this age band, so ask the fostering team which figure applies

extras: The weekly rate includes a carer's component of £103.80 a week for children aged 0 to 10 and £120.20 a week for children aged 11 to 17
Birthday, religious festival and holiday money is built into the weekly rate rather than paid separately
14 nights of paid respite a year, which does not reduce the allowance
Mileage at 45p a mile for travel over 50 miles for a child
Allowances are paid into the carer's bank account every fortnight
summary: Argyll and Bute Council publishes its 2026-27 fostering rates as one weekly amount per child by age. The amount covers the child's upkeep and includes a component for the carer, so no separate fee is listed. The council's own breakdown on the same page gives slightly higher totals for the 5 to 10 and 16 to 17 bands, so confirm the exact figure with the fostering team.
